problem_text: Consider a uniform circular motion where a string neither stretches nor is loose. There is a body of mass (m) 5.0 kg tied to one end, the radius of the circle (R) is 5.0 meters and the speed of the object is 5.0 m/s. The motion is vertical and the acceleration due to gravity (g) at that location is 10.0 m/s$^2$. Calculate the tension in the string at the bottom of the circle.
